levels.surface: سهل بن حماد أبو عتاب الدلال

notes: The report opens «وعن عثمان بن أبي شيبة» and names him in the text: read from the text alone; the previous reports do not name him, so nothing is inherited
«عن أبيه قال: كنت عند رسول الله» — the father speaks in his own words: last link, a bare relation
«عمّي جالس» is scene, not a link
